entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: A Renaissance-like plane of intrigue and city-states, birth plane of Dack Fayden and Daretti.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: Human planeswalker born on Fiora whose hometown Drakeston was wiped out by Sifa Grent.

entities.name: Daretti
entities.description: Goblin planeswalker from Fiora who instigated the goblin riots.

entities.name: Brago
entities.description: Former minor lord who became king of Paliano, made immortal, killed by Selvala and left as a ruling spirit.

entities.name: Marchesa d'Amati
entities.description: Noblewoman who hired Kaya to put Brago to rest and became queen.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: Ghost assassin and planeswalker hired by Marchesa.

entities.name: Adriana Vallore
entities.description: Brago's former guard captain who fomented a rebellion.

entities.name: Muzzio
entities.description: Visionary architect whose bid for power led to cogwork being eliminated.

entities.name: Sifa Grent
entities.description: Wiped out Drakeston using the Ancient Fang.

entities.name: Custodi
entities.description: Brago's advisors who made him immortal.

entities.name: Drakeston
entities.description: A ghost town, Dack Fayden's hometown.

entities.name: Trest
entities.description: Elven port city-state and Paliano's primary rival.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Fiora was a target.

events.summary: Cogwork is eliminated from Paliano's streets after a bid for power by Muzzio.
events.quote: cogwork was eliminated from the streets of Paliano after a bid for power by Muzzio

events.summary: Selvala kills the immortal Brago, inadvertently releasing him as a spirit to rule eternally.
events.quote: his ally Selvala of Alberon killed him

events.summary: Marchesa hires Kaya Cassir to put Brago to rest.
events.quote: the noblewoman Marchesa d'Amati hired the ghost assassin Kaya Cassir to finally put Brago to rest

events.summary: Adriana Vallore foments rebellion while Daretti instigates the goblin riots.
events.quote: the Fioran goblin planeswalker Daretti instigated the goblin riots

events.summary: Fiora is targeted in the New Phyrexian Invasion but Queen Marchesa turns away all trespassers.
events.quote: but Queen Marchesa refused all who trespassed

events.summary: Sifa Grent wipes out Drakeston with the Ancient Fang while Dack is away.
events.quote: until it was wiped out by Sifa Grent using the Ancient Fang
